title: Constraint Expansion
equation: Growth = Bottleneck Capacity Added ÷ Prior Capacity
hook: More hours didn't grow the business. Fixing the one stuck step did.
statement: Growth means finding your bottleneck and making it bigger.
explainer: Improve around the bottleneck and nothing moves. Widen it and everything does.

closing_statement: Fix the real bottleneck or nothing changes.
